argDescriptions.new: modifierTable: `duration` sets the duration. All keys reach `OnCreated`/`OnRefresh` on the server: numbers and strings as is, booleans as 1/0, vectors as `"x y z"` strings; handles, tables and functions are dropped with a warning. On the client these functions get only engine keys (`creationtime`, `duration`, `stack_count`, `isProvidedByAura`, `isCurrentlyInAuraRange`, `auraOwner`).

description.new: Replaces the base mana regeneration: returning `0` or nothing removes it.
Percentage of the base armor that is kept: `100` keeps it unchanged, `0` or nothing removes it. Values above 100% are ignored.
Multiplier of incoming damage before reductions: `1` keeps it unchanged, `0` or nothing blocks all damage.
Happens when a unit damages itself with `DOTA_DAMAGE_FLAG_HPLOSS` (Soul Ring, Armlet, `ApplyDamage` with the unit as both attacker and victim); `attacker` and `unit` are that unit.
Called once for every planted tree.
